paragraphs: He was a lender at interest, and Rava disqualified him from testimony. (See Sanhedrin 25a.)[^1][^2]

notes.text: An isolated כ precedes the source citation.

The named William Davidson Sanhedrin 25a paragraph explicitly names Bar Binitos, reports lending at interest, and gives Rava as the person disqualifying him. The source’s isolated כ and the existing note about it are preserved without expansion. No additional witnesses, details of their testimony or legal conclusions are imported.
